title: Logic: High School Logic and Reasoning Puzzles

LOGIC.ARGUMENT.01.title: Identify statements, premises, conclusions and unstated assumptions in an argument

LOGIC.ARGUMENT.02.title: Tell deductive conclusions (forced by the premises) from inductive ones (supported by examples)

LOGIC.CODE.01.title: Decode and encode with a stated symbol or value key, and infer a key from examples within a stated family

LOGIC.CONDITIONAL.01.title: Find the truth value of a conditional and identify the one case that makes it false

LOGIC.CONDITIONAL.03.title: Form the converse, inverse and contrapositive and decide which are equivalent to the original

LOGIC.CONDITIONAL.04.title: Find truth values of biconditionals and use them as definitions

LOGIC.CONNECTIVE.01.title: Form the negation of a statement and find truth values of simple statements

LOGIC.CONNECTIVE.02.title: Find truth values of conjunctions and of inclusive and exclusive disjunctions

LOGIC.CONSTRAINT.01.title: Find the only candidate left after applying every clue to a finite list

LOGIC.CONSTRAINT.02.title: Translate puzzle clues into exact conditions and test candidate arrangements against them

LOGIC.CONSTRAINT.03.title: Decide what must be true, what could be true and what cannot be true in a constrained arrangement

LOGIC.EVIDENCE.01.title: Identify the unstated assumption an argument needs and evaluate competing explanations

LOGIC.EVIDENCE.02.title: Decide whether the given information determines the answer, and what extra fact would

LOGIC.EVIDENCE.03.title: Judge whether evidence supports a claim: samples, comparisons and correlation

LOGIC.FALLACY.01.title: Recognize common informal fallacies in self-contained arguments

LOGIC.GRAPH.01.title: Trace routes in a drawn network and decide which routes exist under stated rules

LOGIC.GRAPH.02.title: Turn a map into a neighbor (adjacency) graph and reason about neighbor counts and colorings

LOGIC.GRID.01.title: Solve a matching puzzle with a grid by combining clues until one assignment remains

LOGIC.GRID.02.title: Fill and analyze letter grids under stated rules and a supplied word list

LOGIC.INFERENCE.01.title: Draw valid conclusions with modus ponens, modus tollens, chains and disjunctive syllogism

LOGIC.INFERENCE.02.title: Recognize affirming the consequent and denying the antecedent, and show why they fail

LOGIC.INFERENCE.03.title: Tell whether an argument is valid, and whether it is also sound

LOGIC.INVARIANT.01.title: Use odd/even and alternation to predict outcomes and rule out possibilities

LOGIC.INVARIANT.02.title: Find a quantity that never changes under the allowed moves and use it to prove a target is impossible

LOGIC.KNIGHTS.01.title: Find who tells the truth when each speaker either always tells the truth or always lies

LOGIC.OPTIMIZE.01.title: Find the best value under stated constraints and show nothing better is possible

LOGIC.ORDER.01.title: Build an ordering that satisfies relational clues (before, after, between, next to)

LOGIC.PATTERN.01.title: Identify the rule in a stated family that fits a sequence, and continue it

LOGIC.PROOF.01.title: Build a direct argument about even, odd and multiples from definitions

LOGIC.PROOF.02.title: Explain each step in solving an equation and justify the solution method

LOGIC.PROOF.03.title: Set up and complete an argument by contradiction

LOGIC.PROOF.04.title: Find a counterexample that disproves a general mathematical claim

LOGIC.PROOF.05.title: Order and justify the steps of proofs about angles formed by intersecting and parallel lines

LOGIC.QUANT.01.title: Decide the truth of "all", "some" and "no" statements over a stated finite domain

LOGIC.QUANT.02.title: Negate statements with "all", "some", "no", and nested quantifiers

LOGIC.QUANT.03.title: Give a witness for a "some" statement and a counterexample to an "all" statement

LOGIC.READING.01.title: Read negations, double negations, units and relationships exactly as stated

LOGIC.SEARCH.01.title: Organize a complete case analysis and count or find every solution

LOGIC.SEARCH.02.title: Plan weighings or questions and find the least number that always identifies the answer

LOGIC.SEQUENCE.01.title: Carry out stated moves on a row of tokens and find moves that reach a target

LOGIC.SETS.01.title: Mark subset, intersection and complement relations on Venn diagrams

LOGIC.SETS.02.title: Test categorical arguments with Venn diagrams, including the existence assumption

LOGIC.SPATIAL.01.title: Decide whether an image is consistent with a reflection in a horizontal or vertical mirror line

LOGIC.SPATIAL.02.title: Distinguish rotations from reflections of a figure on a grid

LOGIC.SPATIAL.03.title: Infer stacking order from what is visible and predict views of a stack

LOGIC.SPATIAL.04.title: Match a cube to its net: which faces are opposite and which are adjacent

LOGIC.SPATIAL.05.title: Decide which pieces cover a region exactly, and prove when no covering exists

LOGIC.SPATIAL.06.title: Reason about seven-segment digits: segments used, rotations and segment moves

LOGIC.TRUTH.01.title: Complete truth tables for compound statements

LOGIC.TRUTH.02.title: Classify compound statements as tautologies, contradictions or contingencies and test equivalence with a table

LOGIC.WORD.01.title: Use letter counts, positions and alphabetical order to test word patterns within a stated rule

LOGIC.WORD.02.title: Find shortest one-letter-change paths through a supplied word list

LOGIC.WORD.03.title: Find anagrams and letter-bank words within a supplied word list and letter rules

practices.MP1: Make sense of problems and persevere in solving them
practices.MP3: Construct viable arguments and critique the reasoning of others
practices.MP7: Look for and make use of structure
practices.MP8: Look for and express regularity in repeated reasoning
